column8: Spud Hut distribution-center worker who walked out for a smoke break and never returned; probably the TA02 cold-open victim, unconfirmed.

column8: Ranch owner who asks Andrew to have her dead mother exhumed; rents the ranch to Bigelow, dotes on Nancy the goose and asks the team to keep the cavern quiet.
Missing 17-year-old cheerleader and Dr. Lori's patient with a hidden pill stash; found crucified and disemboweled by the highway.

column8: The real Andrew after dying in the gym and reviving in the Roosevelt morgue: two heartbeats, blood hunger, 35 mph, shrugs off bullets; playbook changes from Divine to Monstrous.

Rotating Russian guards at the Metropol: one weeps at soaps and eats the Biz's borscht, one is a hard-ass, one dies in the convoy.

Hostile, bloated Marblehead police chief on the board; goes very still at mention of the melted shoreline; accused of concealing evidence.

Obese black-eyed man in a desert trailer who eats Jell-O and passes grey tendrils into a woman's mouth in two cold opens. WS04 and WS06 figures merged on likeness (unconfirmed).

column5: Salt Lake City radar dealer; equipment dealer; radar rental man

column5: the monk; orange-robed monk; Hare Krishna

Tax-dodging moonshiner on the ridge who saw eyes at his homestead and on whose land the costumed corpse is found.

Former vacuum salesman and Quaalude addict awaiting red-clay baptism into the Covenant.

column5: J. Evans; desk clerk; front desk man

Andrew's mentor in a cosmic-leaning group who delivers the anthill speech and the prophecy that the next master is coming.

Small psychic alien entrant who rides on Derk's shoulders in the briefing tent (\"I'm a quadrillion\") and kindly calls him dumb.

Honest hot dog taco vendor who gives Derk 98 hot dogs and $2 change for a $100 bill, then retreats dry-heaving.
Player character: a vain, scheming 72-year-old would-be mentor with godlike beauty, legendary speed and force fields, who adopted Derk as her mentee.
Sparago's clipboard aide, renamed mid-scene, who explains Ovain's failed dating and journaling and shrugs off Mirabeth's slap.
Anxious many-eyed alien, ex-champion and ex-world conqueror, who attacks the president with white ki fire, fights Derk into space and leaves the planet.

Nervous counter pharmacist who admits Amanda's paper record is missing and hates Dean Lawson; not confirmed to be Derek Augustine.
Cheerful covert operator on the pocket radio who supplies the anti-worm agent, tracks the creature and plans the nuke shot with Kurt.

Alias of a Pay n' Stay guest in fishing hat and heavy coat with a brown station wagon; suspected room searcher, possibly Dr. Lori.

Four-year-old neighbor who saw the spaceman in white with a helmet and a light above the Lucky house.
Circle Chasers member with the undiscovered-hominid theory who produces the tracking device found in bear vomit.

column8: Comatose butterfly-collecting twin who raised the moth and became its thrall; blamed as a serial killer, later healed by Andrew in Roanoke.

Shell-shocked father of the twins, about sixty, who watched his wife walk away; first called Josiah, corrected to Yobiah.
Chain-smoking cop of about 22 who drives the agents to the pharmacy, is hurt by Huell's rude gesture, and is shot dead stepping out of the car.

column8: Roosevelt junkyard owner pressured into falsely confessing to crushing the rental; later sole survivor of the police massacre, shot and missing a toe. \"I hate it here so much.\"
FBI agent clearing boxes out of the barbershop.
Check Kurt's spear gun and Andrew's blood powder.
Evasive physician who withholds X-rays and mails Andrew human blood weekly. RE01 says his mother in California is his physician; not confirmed as the same person.
Devout single mother and church member staying with Andrew in DC.
Elijah Ray's youngest wife.
Staff at the Biz's building who run a betting pool on his death and hand over the key.
Reimbursed Derek $100 and recognized the drifter.
Unnamed attackers who file into the gym behind the double; one shotguns Andrew, many die to the grenade.
Lifelong Ballard resident with an enormous beehive; defends the town, resents the community center, misses Reagan.
Listless lone clerk who patches Huell's bite and says Ballard has no homeless. Not confirmed to be the beehive clerk.
Co-worker who covered Aaron's shift.
Unnamed male secretary who takes Kurt's request about Jordan Gramoire.
Woken by the night phone call in the finale's cold open.
Curt, unfamiliar doorman who turns Kurt away at night.
Big burly guard who makes pancakes for the team.
Unnamed psychiatrist who debriefs the party for 45 minutes after the night event.
Camcorder-holding hunter; possibly Delilah (unconfirmed).
Kicked him and asked about Clinton before Yeltsin's people took over.

Toby's son, who made the volcano.
Sheriff McDermish's deadpan seven-year-old son; watches Aladdin, wins at Monopoly, later taken out of state \"to see the aunts\".
Suited hostage sent out twice with a brick cellphone and the gunman's phone number.
Gives sleepwalking Andrew a free ride.
Admits the team to the Sportsman RV Campground.
Poncho-wearing cleanup-crew searcher disabled by Andrew's mace and robbed of poncho and flashlight.
Hungover Roosevelt cop who says only \"Ham\", microwaves Canadian bacon and eavesdrops on the interrogation.
Derek Edwards's partner, who answers the phone.
Friendly driver of the armored surplus truck who delivers the Davy Crockett crate and leaves town on Kurt's warning.
Family on the previous team's contact list; never interviewed.

Big-haired Spud Hut receptionist who lets the team in and leads them to Jan.
Credited photographer of the Dahlonega Times Bigfoot photo; not confirmed to be Derek Edwards.
Offscreen grower of sickly yellow marijuana behind his parents' trailer; the teens' supplier.
Young Covenant woman, Willow's peer.
Bruce's much younger wife or daughter in a clown-print silk bathrobe who lets the agents use the kitchen phone.
Complaining Spud Hut accountant who knew about the mine; possible leak.
Cowboy-hatted man with shotgun, ATV and dog who sees the coyote stand up; may be Gardner's ex-Ranger or Walt (unconfirmed).
Gray-jumpsuited smoker lured into the cave by a baby's cry and attacked; probably Aaron Richters (inferred).
Unidentified teen burying cash in the RH06 cold open; presumably Dean Lawson.
Young woman from the lost Episode 02 who found a body under the wreck and took the team down in an experimental sub. Recap only.
Older man whose car was stolen; plans unheated TV dinners and a book.
shared: House subcommittee chair questioning Kurt about Marblehead.
Laughing man entering the next-door room whom Huell finds oddly familiar.
Unnamed woman who drives into the desert and feeds a coyote white powder from a coffee cup.

Next-door guest who checks on Andrew.
Local officers at the mine search.
Drunken hunters blamed for accidents.
Phoebe's amicable ex-boyfriend, mentioned only; not the same person as Derek Augustine.
Suburban family whose dog was taken from the backyard.
Missing person on one of Molly's posters.
Agent who takes over the Biz's cases.
Woman who lets herself into Doug's trailer with the spare key, finds the Jell-O hoard and is infested by his tendrils.
shared: Andrew's cult-member family doctor.
shared; Radford ER doctor who calls about Andrew's lost blood samples and urges a retest.

Matt's father at the mountain ski lodge.
Missing Ballard local whose trailer sits empty with mail piling up.
Teen delinquent who stole every toilet seat in the school without knowing why.
Ballard resident who shot half his foot off and drove an hour in a manual car to get it treated.
Spud Hut plant worker and Edward's father, who reports Aaron missing.
Maimed skinwalker who vomits his brain-creature into a tank and dies.
Neighbor who saw Phoebe flee into the woods.
Mustard-stained child who rides Huell's elevator all day and asks about his foot.
Missing person on one of Molly's posters.
McDonald's counter kid who recommends Stigley's and the Spud Hut.
Unseen church member who puts bean juice in Esteban's laundry to keep him chaste.
Put Webster through a four-hour debrief over the fence incident.

Polite operator who logs the Biz's double-homicide report, has never heard of the task force, and promises snow-delayed backup.
Unnamed operators who authenticate Huell, warn of the chemical alert, report the Guard delay and cannot send a helicopter.
German translator on the speakerphone call.
Driver turned back at the bridge blockade.

Next in the FBI chain of command above Big Bill.
German-speaking mother interviewed by speakerphone through an FBI translator.

Pinched older newspaper employee who identifies Derek.
Glum acne-faced teen who mixes up the waffle and pancake order.
Kindly National Guard medic who treats Howard, Huell and Kurt, then panics with no chain of command.
Middle-aged woman who sells Huell a trash bag for a dollar; her cousin draws the shop's axolotls.
Repeat complainer to the sheriff about her missing Doberman, Harvey Milk.
Drebin's shoulder-riding iguana with \"mad lizard eyes\".
Phone voice who reports the Voyager on Lagoon Street and tells Howard to keep better track of his car.
Escort at the Roanoke mental hospital.
Kid who explains pig tips.
Huell's old unit, who send the stuffed alien.
Kurtis's wife, said to be a former Viet Cong; home-schools their children.
Two unnamed members of the five-person gold-mining ring.
D.C. lawyer friend, newly a federal judge, phoned by the Biz.
Name on the porn-shoot register behind the green bag.
Ma Gramoire's National Guard son, who never calls; Kurt asks Big Bill to have him assigned to the deployment.
Person McManley should call.
Handler offering the Biz $10,000.

shared: mentioned as the giver of Kurt's battery watch.
Classmate and friend of Amanda who fought with Phoebe; never interviewed.

Muscular high schooler who speaks for Uncle Trevor and claims they are camping.

Missing person on one of Molly's posters.
Smoker examining Murphy's ash pile in the cold open; apparent leader of the cleanup crew.
Bigelow staffer with recurring drowning nightmares.
Brooks pharmacy employee who keeps the back service door locked; mentioned only.

Harrison's silent friend in the barn: \"We're the fucking worst at crime.\"

Seen carrying Elizabeth George in the cold open; presumably gray van crew.

Nervous trained teens who sort and dust evidence in the RV lab.

Peggy's twin sister.
Missing person on one of Molly's posters.
Missing person on one of Molly's posters.

One-legged Presbyterian preacher (spelling provisional).

Highway patrol contact; name uncertain.

Black site guard who clears the team for four hours.
Girl saving for a horse who describes Billy Thornton's habits; may be Charm, not confirmed.

Tell the lost Derk where he is and give him a package of nuts.
Slightly older rival from her hero days, now in a retirement home; never seen.

Posing, long-haired leader of the gray van crew on the diner tape.

Kurt's supply contact.
Sri Lankan leader whose assassination Kurt says he postponed during his post-task-force posting.

Glowing, sallow bookstore clerk with a fishy open mouth who watches the Biz like a goldfish.
Willow's friend who works the Covenant stills.
Matronly woman, pot-bellied man and two children with knives who ambush McManley; all killed, two found to hold pilots.
Directs the party to Freak.
Armed, rude, Midwestern military-looking man who booked room 111 and bribed the clerk.
Spare-room dentist who replaces the Biz's vanished fillings with gold over five hours.
Doctors keeping the generator for a ventilator patient after the ambulance and radio are stolen.
